purpose: Declare the boundary between in-app layered-worldbook selection and external SillyTavern worldbook injection.

effects: normalize the preset to manifest-listed runtime-installable package IDs
persist the selected preset and package IDs in SaveV2.worldbook
write the same normalized selection to the chat-scoped projection used by the EJS reader
expose the selected package URLs and import instructions in the worldbook package view

projection.consistencyRule: The chat projection must equal the normalized SaveV2.worldbook selection before the runtime reader is used.
projection.failureMeaning: A failed projection write may leave the external EJS reader stale or unavailable; it never proves worldbook injection.

selection.doesNotMean: The selected packages have been imported, enabled, or injected into a SillyTavern prompt.

requiredUserActions: download every package listed for the selected preset
import the packages through the normal SillyTavern worldbook UI
enable only the selected package set and keep L0 exclusive with full packages
appMustNot: call an undocumented SillyTavern worldbook API
write, edit, or delete worldbook entries
claim that a selected package is active in the external host

staticChecksCanProve: selection IDs match the checked-in package manifest
the EJS reader and chat projection use the declared selection variable
the selection projection is declared as the normalized SaveV2.worldbook value
the UI exposes the manual import boundary
no confirmed external API claim is present
staticChecksCannotProve: SillyTavern enabled the selected package set
a worldbook entry reached a model prompt
